ashby:benchling:f353b4e0-05d7-4876-b95f-.summary:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is…

sections.title: ROLE OVERVIEW
paras: The Solution Consultant - Business Value (SCBV) ensures that Benchling’s top customers get a solution that meets their needs precisely and delivers value aligned to the customer's business priorities. Their primary focus will be to engage with customers and executives to help articulate the tangible, strategic, and financial impact that Benchling can deliver to their organizations. SCBV deliverables will ultimately drive the customer’s decision on whether or not Benchling is selected as their solution.

SCBVs will have a strong executive presence and must have prior successful executive interaction. They are particularly adept at combining an in-depth understanding of the scientific and technical challenges with a customer’s business needs to define a tailored solution and the specific benefits of adopting Benchling across the organization. Often the use cases will be new, variable, and complex, and will require creativity in developing new solutions, business cases, and ways of engaging.

SCBVs are also responsible for defining the value journey of our customers in partnership with cross functional stakeholders in sales, solutions consulting, professional services, and customer success. This encompasses both enabling teams on value frameworks as well as developing tools and reusable assets. In addition, SCBVs stay informed about industry trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies.

sections.title: RESPONSIBILITIES
bullets:
Drive growth in our enterprise and strategic customers by leading solution & value assessments during the sales process:

• Coordinate cross functional teams (sales, solutions consulting, product, and professional services) to execute assessments with speed and quality.
Build a deep understanding of the customer’s business needs through meticulous discovery and creatively adapt assessment framework to meet customer’s decision process

Create and present executive-level deliverables that capture current state analysis and future state recommendations using leading practices and bridging customer challenges to Benchling capabilities and identified value
Maintain open, proactive communication and documentation of engagement progress, meetings, deliverables, stakeholders, and key decisions.
Develop methodologies to quantify strategic, operational, and financial metrics for customers and use these metrics to clearly demonstrate the measurable value Benchling delivers

Create reusable assets to drive the adoption of Benchling’s value framework in the end-to-end customer journey in partnership with cross functional stakeholders (solutions consulting, professional services, and customer success)

Provide thought leadership about industry trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies. Use this knowledge to effectively position Benchling and identify opportunities for differentiation.
Share insights and feedback from customer interactions to the product and marketing teams to help refine Benchling's offerings and messaging.

sections.title: QUALIFICATIONS
bullets: It is highly preferred that candidates have 4-7 years experience in a scientific domain - particularly biologics, industrial biotech, or early/late development.
Ideal candidates will have a Masters or PhD in a scientific field or work experience that gives them exposure to scientific fields.
Outstanding ability to convey value proposition and insights drawing from prior industry experience and in-depth knowledge of Benchling products and use cases
Experience creating written deliverables that assess current state, propose a future state solution, outline the value/case for change, and a roadmap to deliver on the case for change.

Effective at cross-functional leadership. Many subject matter experts contribute to assessments, roadmaps, architectures, and proposals and this person needs to provide leadership that sets everyone up for success.
Strong executive presence and the ability to quickly establish credibility and trust with senior business leaders as well as internal stakeholders
Dynamic, empathetic and flexible in communication and work styles depending on context and in multi-cultural teams and engagements
Willingness to travel to customer sites 25-30% of the time

sections.title: HOW WE WORK
paras: We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

paras: We are hiring a Director of Product for the Clasp Student Finance business line. We’ve seen rapid acceleration since recent federal student loan policy changes. Build a repeatable way to onboard and integrate schools, including how they certify loans and how we connect to their student information systems. We need to launch enterprise university customers without custom builds
Decide where we make our product bets – prioritize across student application experience, university customer asks, and platform modernization

Learn our lending platform end to end, from application and disclosures through school certification, data and disbursement with our bank and servicing partners. Become the person everyone goes to with product questions about it.
Become an expert on student loan policy and where Clasp can go to continue to meet the needs of students and universities. You should be deeply passionate about the problem space.

Experience managing direct reports and building a team: you’ve hired, created an org chart, and coached PMs.

Experience with in-school student loans. You don’t need to have spent your entire career in this space, but we need someone who understands the basic mechanics of financial aid packaging, loan applications, certification and disbursement, and servicing.
Experience partnering with Compliance to balance risk with the Product vision.

Commercial judgment. You connect customer problems to revenue, and you can make a clear tradeoff when schools, students, and internal teams want different things.
You take a position and defend it. You've disagreed with senior leaders, done the research to back up your view, and changed decisions while keeping their trust.

ashby:lambda:7ea9a4fa-7b86-4464-a921-24f.summary:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.

If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.

*Note: This position requires presence in our Bellevue or San Francisco office location 4 days per week; Lambda’s designated work from home day is currently Tuesday.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Customers come to Lambda for compute, and then decide whether to stay based on where their data lives. Weights, checkpoints, and training sets are the part of the workload that is expensive to move and painful to lose, so storage is where a GPU rental turns into a cloud a customer builds on.

As a product manager on the Foundational Infrastructure team, you will own a meaningful part of defining where customer data lives on Lambda and how it reaches the GPUs. The domain covers the storage customers attach to an instance and the storage that outlives it, from local disk through block volumes to shared and object storage. It covers how customers get large datasets in and keep them current, and what throughput they can count on when thousands of processes read the same data at once or checkpoint into it together. It covers what customers are promised about durability, isolation, and key handling before an enterprise will put production on us. It covers how capacity is tiered, partitioned between shared and dedicated, metered, and priced, including what data transfer costs and who pays for it. Much of the stack is vendor-provided today, and deciding what Lambda should own instead is part of the work. You will work across these areas depending on which customer needs are burning hottest, alongside the other product managers on the team.

Most of this is the feature set a mature cloud already has and Lambda does not have yet. A neocloud is not a hyperscaler, though, and copying that list wholesale is the wrong instinct. Part of the job is judgment about which of those capabilities matter here and which carry cost we should not pay. The other part is that AI workloads read and write in patterns these primitives were never designed for, and deciding where that difference should change the product is the more interesting half.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Find the Real Problem: Get close to customers, deals, escalations, and support on On-Demand GPU Instances and 1-Click Clusters, and work out what is actually blocking them on data rather than what they asked for.
Decide What Matters: Rank and sequence the work across the storage portfolio, and be honest about what Lambda is not doing this year and why.
Write the Definition: Produce requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria precise enough that engineering builds from them without a translation layer.

Price and Package It: Decide how capacity, performance, and data transfer are metered, priced, and packaged across On-Demand GPU Instances, 1-Click Clusters, and Lambda's private cloud offerings, including whether storage should bill alongside the GPUs it serves or on its own.

Deliver With Engineering: Work through the build with the storage teams and the vendors behind parts of the stack today, make the tradeoff calls that come up mid-flight, and keep scope honest against the date.

Land the Launch: Set launch criteria that cover the operational readiness a storage product needs, including durability, recovery, and what customers are told when data is at risk, and get documentation, pricing, sales, and support in place before it goes live rather than after.
Measure and Iterate: Define what success looks like before launch, then go find out whether it happened, using adoption and real workload performance rather than opinion.
Make the Call Stick: Take a position on contested tradeoffs, write it down well enough that people can disagree with it precisely, and keep owning the decision after it is made.

sections.title: You
bullets: Have 7+ years of product management experience, including time on storage products at a hyperscaler, neocloud, or comparable cloud provider.
Have shipped storage that external customers ran production workloads on, in object, file, or block.
Understand the storage path well enough to reason with engineers about throughput, latency, consistency, and what happens to a workload when a device or a node fails.
Understand how data placement and read and write patterns show up as performance for distributed training and large-scale inference.
Have owned a product where durability and day two behavior mattered as much as launch, including recovery, capacity exhaustion, and what customers are told when something breaks.
Have owned pricing, packaging, or metering for an infrastructure product, including the data transfer side of it.
Can tell which parts of a hyperscaler playbook transfer to an AI cloud and which are cost without benefit.
Have worked with storage vendors and open source storage systems, and can decide what Lambda should build against what it should buy.

sections.title: Nice to Have
bullets: Experience with object storage and S3-compatible interfaces, including the compatibility gaps that matter to customers porting from a hyperscaler.
Experience with parallel or shared file systems at high throughput, and with the quality of service controls that keep one tenant from taking the whole system.
Experience with block storage, snapshots, or the storage path behind instance boot and recovery.
Experience moving bulk data into a cloud, including resume, integrity verification, and throughput the customer can watch.
Experience with encryption at rest, key management, and tenant isolation in a multi-tenant storage system.
Familiarity with how storage traffic crosses a high performance fabric, like remote direct memory access or GPUDirect Storage.

ashby:overjet:aad8bd69-ade0-4b87-a5bd-a3.summary:
Overjet is the world-leader in dental AI. Already, thousands of dental providers and insurers rely on our platform to deliver the best possible care. Now, we’re looking for talented people to fulfill our mission: improve oral health for all.

Overjet is where builders become leaders. Everyone here loves to make new things: new products, new partnerships, new content, and a new category of AI technology. And as Overjet grows ridiculously fast, so will you.

Simply put, there’s no better place to accelerate your career. Come join us!

sections.title: The Mission and the Hard Part
paras: Dental insurance still runs on people working phones, payer portals, PDFs, and spreadsheets: verifying benefits, chasing claim status, processing coordination of benefits, validating provider data, credentialing dentists. Overjet is replacing that work with agents (voice, browser, and document agents built on a shared platform) that are already running in production for enterprise payers and DSOs. Every agent that works earns a customer’s trust and shrinks their human queue. Every agent that doesn’t lands in a human review queue the next morning, with a customer asking why. The Lead PM decides which jobs an agent should be given, how we know it did them correctly, and when a person steps in.

You’ll own an agent product area end to end, reporting to our Insurance product leader and working daily with Engineering, ML, Customer Success, and Sales. What makes this hard is that there is no established playbook for it. Agent behavior is probabilistic, so the spec is an eval set rather than a PRD. Success is measured in tasks resolved without a human, not features adopted. The customers are regulated enterprises with real SLAs, and the workflows are messy, undocumented, and different at every payer. If turning an operating procedure nobody has written down into an agent that holds up on call number 10,000 sounds like the fun part of the job, keep reading.

sections.title: What You’ll Own
bullets: A named agent product area, from problem selection through production, whether that’s claims, provider network management, eligibility and benefits, or payer-provider workflows. That means deciding which jobs agents take over and which stay with people, and cutting the ones that don’t earn their place.

The definition of “working” for every agent you ship. That means task-level success criteria, evals, confidence thresholds, and escalation rules, plus reading real transcripts and traces every week instead of trusting a dashboard.

The human-in-the-loop experience: review queues, approval gates, and exception handling. That means the people who remain in the workflow see only what needs judgment, and the volume reaching them falls release over release.

Customer outcomes in production, from pilot to rollout with payers and DSOs: resolution rate, cost per task, turnaround time, and escalation volume. That means sitting in discovery calls and turning each customer’s real operating procedures into agent instructions and measurable targets.

Your agents’ contribution to the shared platform. That means pushing for reusable primitives (voice, browser automation, document parsing, tool access, audit logging, settings, guardrails) instead of one-off builds, so the next agent is mostly configuration.

sections.title: The Opportunity
paras: SandboxAQ’s AI Simulation (AISim) division develops and applies Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) that are grounded in physics, chemistry, mathematics and biology to simulate molecular behavior with scientific precision and accelerate discovery in the physical world across biopharma, chemicals, advanced materials, healthcare, and so much more.

Within AISim, ChemSim is SandboxAQ's AI-driven materials discovery platform. We are seeking an exceptional Product Manager to own the Catalysis vertical. This is a dual-mandate role. In the near term, you will be the product owner for catalysis within SandboxAQ's $500M CHIPS Act R&D award from the U.S. Department of Commerce, translating contractual objectives into product requirements and external fulfilment, whilst partnering with Program Managers to ensure successful milestone delivery. In parallel, you will build the commercial foundation that turns catalysis from a government-funded R&D workstream into a product-led business generating durable, recurring revenue from the broader materials and process-chemistry market.

Catalysis is one of the largest and most consequential application areas in applied chemistry. It underpins refining and downstream oil and gas, commodity and petrochemical production, emissions control, and the energy transition (hydrogen electrolysis, carbon utilization, e-fuels and chemical recycling etc) alongside semiconductor process chemistry and fine chemical synthesis. Across nearly all of these markets the bottleneck is the same: catalyst discovery and optimization remain slow, experimental and expensive, and the simulation tools available today answer narrower questions than the ones that actually decide a process. This is a once-in-a-career opportunity to shape a category-defining AI platform for materials science at the intersection of national security, scientific discovery, and commercial scale.

bullets: Own the end-to-end Catalysis product strategy, vision and roadmap, spanning CHIPS Act contractual deliverables, vertical scientific depth, and commercial expansion into new markets.

Define the dataset and model requirements for the vertical, chemical coverage, fidelity, and the benchmarking that determines where simulation investment is directed in partnership with our scientific and ML teams.
Drive the roadmap from property and energetics prediction toward reaction-level modelling, so that predictions can be validated against a customer's own process rather than assessed in isolation.

Contribute to the catalysis commercial strategy with commercial leadership: customer segmentation, scope of offer, packaging, and pricing model across semiconductor, refining and petrochemical, emissions control and energy-transition customers.

Build, manage, and own strategic partner relationships at the product level: Work with fabs and equipment OEMs, precursor and specialty materials suppliers, refiners and chemical producers, catalyst manufacturers, national laboratories and validation partners, translating partner requirements into product features.

Define and track strategic product and commercial KPIs: Manage the metrics that matter most including, Model accuracy requirements, workflow adoption, customer segment expansion, and recurring revenue growth , and drive course corrections against OKRs.
Develop and defend build-vs-buy and build-vs-partner recommendations for domain-specific scientific engines, datasets and validation tooling.

sections.title: Why I'm hiring
paras: At Whippy, we view Customer Success as a revenue engine, not a cost center, because if customers don't get value from a tool, they'll leave. That's how we evolved from a simple texting platform to now powering calls, texts, email, AI agents, and complex messaging and business automations for over 1,000 businesses. We ship fast to meet our customers' needs.

Most customers start with one use case, like a staffing firm using an AI voice agent to screen candidates. They stay and grow because they see real ROI, then expand use cases until Whippy becomes the infrastructure their business runs on. Your job is to drive that growth: make their first outcome happen during onboarding and implementation, uncover the next problem, and help them get even more value.

In this role, you'll mainly work with customers in the staffing industry. Their data flows into Whippy from their ATS, most often TempWorks, Avionte, Aqore/Zenople, Crelate, or Bullhorn, so you'll learn how staffing firms recruit and place talent, and how to build on top of their data.

Own your gross and net revenue retention , and get rewarded for beating targets.
Tie usage to business outcomes , and report value back in the metrics customers actually care about.

paras: This is a high-performance environment, and I'll coach and support you through it. You'll be challenged, coached, and you'll always know where you stand. CS is a team sport, so it's okay to ask for help, experiment, fail, and pivot. A few things that are true here:
bullets: Everyone is a builder. Our team builds in the product without engineering, and the best product ideas come from you, the person closest to the customer. We use AI to move fast, but we own our work, verify every fact, and don't ship slop.
We lead with expertise, not order-taking. We get curious about the why behind every request, and we say no when no is the right answer.
We work like owners, not clock-watchers. We care about outcomes, not hours. We take initiative, pick up the phone, and work obsessively on the problem in front of us.
CS is a revenue engine, not a cost center. We treat it as the growth engine of the company and pay for results.

sections.title: What we're looking for
bullets: Communication above all. This is the number one predictor of success in this role. You overcommunicate by default with customers, your team, and me. You're clear in writing and on calls, you set expectations, and you never leave people guessing.
Fast and proactive. You process information quickly, ask for what you need instead of waiting, and show up to every call prepared.
Curious, coachable, and low-ego. You're a fast learner who wants feedback, digs into the why behind every request, and gets better quickly.

Strategic and commercial. You see usage and growth, not just tickets, and you're comfortable owning a number and an upgrade conversation.

Self-directed. You take initiative, stay organized without being told, and run your own book without anyone managing your calendar. Calm under pressure.

paras: Optain operates EyePACS, the largest teleophthalmology network in the United States. Hundreds of organizations use it, from federally qualified health centers and county health systems to primary care practices and home-health programs. Clinics capture retinal images during a routine primary care visit and upload them, manually or from their EHR, to the EyePACS store-and-forward platform. Credentialed optometrists and ophthalmologists read the images and return e-consults with diagnoses and follow-up recommendations, so clinics can close care gaps for patients with diabetes without a separate specialist visit.

As Product Manager at Optain , you will own the EyePACS platform end to end: how clinics enroll patients and submit images, how consultants review cases and write e-consults, how results and referrals reach the clinic and its EHR, and how programs are implemented, billed and measured. You will work closely with clinical leadership, the consultant network, engineering, implementation and commercial teams across the US and Australia.

This is a hands-on role in a growing company. EyePACS has run since 2003 and serves clinics with very different needs and levels of technical maturity. You will find the highest-leverage problems in a high-volume clinical service, modernize a long-established platform, and ship improvements that make screening programs faster, more reliable and financially sustainable for our health system partners.

sections.title: What You'll Do:

Coordinate between the core Optain client and ML team roadmaps to ensure deliveries and cross-team initiatives align.

Build tools for the consultant network. Partner with clinical leadership to improve how credentialed optometrists and ophthalmologists receive, review and report cases, including turnaround time, workload balancing, quality review and second opinions on difficult cases.

Make programs easy to launch and sustain. Work with implementation and support teams on onboarding, workflow and billing setup, staff training and certification, and the ongoing program support that clinics rely on.

Support reimbursement and quality programs. Make sure the platform supports accurate billing (CPT coding), documentation, ROI reporting and quality measures such as HEDIS diabetic eye exam and Medicare Stars.

Turn data into decisions. Define and track metrics such as screening volume, image gradability, time from upload to e-consult, referral follow-through and care-gap closure, and share them with clinics and internal teams.

Lead discovery and delivery. Run research with clinics, health systems and consultants; write clear requirements, user stories and release notes; and work with engineering and design from concept through launch and adoption.
Unify the platform. Help bring EyePACS and Optain's broader product suite into one coherent experience for customers.
Protect patient data. Work with security and compliance to keep the platform aligned with HIPAA, role-based access and customer security requirements.

sections.title: Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams
paras: Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.
To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:
bullets: No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

Please always verify communications:


• Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com .

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

They deeply understand complex regulatory spaces like FinTech, Healthcare, and HRTech, and have a keen intuition for how to connect threads across our customers’ needs and our business’ risk management and commercialization strategy. Our Product Managers lead highly collaborative creative endeavors, bringing together stakeholders across engineering, design, data services, operations, and customer-facing teams to deliver tangible value.
By joining us, you’ll be part of an experienced team of Product Managers who have a proven track record of building large-scale software products that impact small businesses worldwide.

We’re looking for teammates who will help shape Justworks’ future and make a profound impact on our business. As a Product Manager, you’ll be working across complex spaces (Fintech, Healthcare, HR Tech - all with serious policy/regulatory environments). Care is at the center of everything we do, and you’ll need to love talking with customers and engaging with our Customer Success, Sales and Marketing teams to make sure that care is coming through in every part of our customers’ experience. You’ll be joining a diverse community of craftspeople who are passionate about learning, uphold exceptionally high standards of quality, and foster an environment of strategic thinking where product people can reach new heights.

sections.title: About the role
paras: The Global Time team's mission is to help small businesses manage their global teams seamlessly and compliantly by providing an intuitive time experience for managers and their teams around the world. You'll also partner closely with our Time Worked and Time Off pods to strengthen the foundation of our Time solutions in ways that benefit every Justworks customer.

As a Product Manager for Global Time, you'll work with GPMs across the Time and International Payroll space to drive one of the most consequential areas of our global product: enabling hourly and part-time employment for our Employer of Record (EOR) offering across international markets. You'll lead key initiatives — from adapting legal frameworks and building guided, compliant overtime management, to localizing the time tracking experience for a global workforce, to adding the flexibility customers need to manage variable shift work.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: Demonstrate ownership for the products you build and an understanding of shipping services that can perform and scale with Justworks.

Lead discovery into complex, country-specific requirements — pay rates and standard hours, timesheets, overtime calculations, statutory-holiday tracking, and payroll timing — and translate them into coherent, scalable product requirements.

Shape the strategy and roadmap for key Time Global initiatives and articulate a compelling vision of impact on our international business to stakeholders across the product and engineering organizations.
Identify where international needs expose needs in core infrastructure, and partner with adjacent pods to improve the foundation for all customers.
Use customer feedback, data, and competitive research to sequence the roadmap and make clear, well-reasoned prioritization calls.
Define success metrics and measure outcomes, iterating toward increased revenue and reduced sales and operational friction.
Set a high bar for quality, compliance, and risk management in a domain where errors carry regulatory and financial consequences.
Partner deeply with engineering to investigate and prioritize issues/bugs and develop technical knowledge with their guidance.

greenhouse:kaseya:6146931004.summary:
Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners , a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in…

sections.title: About Kaseya
paras: We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.
At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

AI is fundamentally changing how IT and security work gets done — shifting customers from operating software to directing intelligent systems that do the work for them. Kaseya is investing in leading that shift.
bullets: Own the vision and multi-year strategy for Kaseya's AI agent platform — the foundation that lets customers extend, customize, and run intelligent automation across their IT and security workflows.
Define the customer extensibility model that allows customers and partners to tailor platform capabilities to their unique environments, without exposing complexity they don't need to see.
Shape the runtime experience — how automated workflows are configured, executed, observed, and governed reliably and at scale across diverse customer environments.
Partner across product lines to expose the right capabilities, data, and interfaces so the platform can act meaningfully across Kaseya's portfolio and drive architectural consistency across teams.
Define the APIs, SDKs, and builder experiences that make the platform easy, safe, and rewarding to build on — for internal teams, partners, and customers alike.
Connect platform capabilities to monetization by partnering with GTM, pricing, and packaging teams to translate platform value into durable revenue and adoption.
Raise the bar on platform product management practices and represent the platform in executive forums with crisp narratives tied to business outcomes.
5+ years of product management experience on platform, developer platform, automation, AI/ML, extensibility, or runtime products operating at scale .

greenhouse:leapwork:5031361101.summary:
At Leapwork, we are at the center of the most important shift happening in enterprise software right now, with AI changing how software is built across every industry and every enterprise. We sit at this intersection, and what makes us different is the combination no one else brings: agentic, application agnostic, and deterministic by design across the full software delivery lifecycle.

We are trusted by some of the world's most respected brands across financial services, pharma, manufacturing, and retail. paras: As an Enterprise Solution Consultant at Leapwork, you engage with enterprise customers and partners across complex sales cycles, guiding them from initial discovery through executive playback, solution design, and business value articulation.

Your primary focus is consultative solution selling, partnering with customers to understand their business objectives, shape technical solutions, and demonstrate measurable value across Leapwork’s platform capabilities. You will work across multiple stakeholders both within the prospect organization and internally at Leapwork.

You play a critical role in early discovery, deliver compelling value-based demonstrations, conduct business value assessments and technical deep dives, and support differentiated proof-of-value engagements, all culminating in strategic playback to executive audiences.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
bullets: Lead consultative discovery to understand customer goals, challenges, and success criteria
Deliver tailored demonstrations and technical walkthroughs aligned to business outcomes
Own technical validation delivery and proof-of-value engagements in partnership with account executive, including agreed success criteria and business outcomes.
Partner closely with Sales to influence deal strategy and qualification
Articulate Leapwork’s value proposition across platform capabilities
Share structured feedback from the field to inform Product and GTM teams

sections.title: Preferred Skills & Experience
bullets: 3+ years pre-sales experience and a demonstrated track record of consistently meeting or exceeding annual quota and performance targets
Experience with and knowledge of the software development lifecycle. (Testing domain knowledge is not mandatory but would be beneficial)
Preferably experience with MEDDIC sales methodology as the Leapwork sales concept is based upon this framework
Curiosity and intelligence to proficiently uncover, understand and absorb new information
A highly structured mindset with tenacity and persistence to get things done
Ability to articulate complex ideas and strategies
High energy and attention to detail

sections.title: Why Leapwork?
paras: We are on an exciting global growth journey, and this is your chance to jump on board and contribute to digital transformation initiatives at Leapwork. You’ll work alongside and learn from a talented and passionate team committed to both innovation and excellence.
By joining our team, you’ll be part of an international environment where you can grow, challenge yourself, and do what inspires you. We work hard but have fun while doing it.

greenhouse:lumahealth:8779705002.summary:
Needing healthcare can be hard — getting care shouldn’t be.

We built Luma Health because we are all patients. We believe it should be easy to see and connect with our doctor. To get the care we need, when we need it.

So, we’ve created solutions to fix this problem. Our technology makes messaging easier, scheduling appointments more efficient, and it modernizes care delivery from beginning to end.

paras: We are looking for a highly driven and empathetic Customer Success Executive to serve as a trusted advisor to our strategic customer base, comprising large health & hospital systems and Academic Medical Centers across the country.

As a Senior Customer Success Executive (CSE), you will play a key role in ensuring our customers derive maximum value from our products and services. You will manage a portfolio of strategic healthcare clients, responsible for building strong relationships at all levels within the customer’s organization, and acting as a trusted advisor. You will be responsible for driving customer adoption, usage, satisfaction, retention, and growth, while leveraging deep industry and product knowledge to support our clients' long-term success.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities:
bullets: Customer Relationship Management:
Develop and nurture relationships with key stakeholders at healthcare organizations, including executive teams, clinical leaders, and operational managers.
Serve as the primary point of contact for high-value clients, ensuring their needs are met and addressing concerns in a timely, professional manner.
Onboarding & Adoption:
Lead the team through the onboarding of new customers, working closely with internal teams to ensure seamless implementation and integration of our solutions into customer workflows.
Drive product adoption and usage, working with clients to optimize their use of the platform and ensuring they achieve their desired outcomes.

Work closely with clients to understand their business goals, challenges, and strategic priorities, tailoring solutions to meet their needs.

sections.title: Who You Are
bullets: 5+ years of relevant work experience in customer success or account management. SaaS experience preferred
Excellent project management skills and ability to collaborate across multiple internal and external stakeholders

You have proven success in building trust and driving results for a broad range of stakeholders: senior executives, IT, and day-to-day users of the software
Ability to quickly identify underlying drivers of problems, quickly develop hypotheses, and execute on a path to solve

Process building experience
Upsell experience

paras: As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you will serve as the technical lead across client engagements, bridging business strategy with hands-on technical architecture, implementation, and quality assurance. You will own complex technical workstreams end-to-end leading discovery, translating measurement and business requirements into scalable architectures across Adobe Target, Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Real-Time CDP, Customer Journey Analytics (CJA), and modern tag management platforms.
bullets: Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Lead technical discovery and requirements-gathering sessions with developers, analysts, marketers, and product teams. Document comprehensive solution designs, technical requirements, implementation approaches, and system dependencies while proactively identifying risks and limitations.

AEP Web SDK Implementation: Lead hands-on implementation and configuration of Adobe Experience Platform Web SDK, datastreams, edge decisioning, and personalization. Monitor and debug network payloads and server responses to ensure accurate data flow into AEP datasets and downstream tools.

Tag Management & Data Layer Architecture: Architect, evaluate, and implement data layer designs across Adobe Launch/Tags and Google Tag Manager (GTM). Manage and troubleshoot rule conditions, custom extensions, data elements, and tag firing.

Diagnose and fix complex issues involving JavaScript errors, cookies, local/session storage, identity stitching, event duplication, data loss, and reporting discrepancies.

Client Advisory & Technical Leadership: Act as a trusted technical lead on engagements. Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, present architectural recommendations, and constructively challenge requirements to balance business goals with technical feasibility and maintainability.

bullets: Direct Leadership: Reports to the Engineering Director or Practice Lead, Marketing Technology & Personalization.
Internal Capabilities: Partner closely with developers, analysts, data architects, QA engineers, and client engagement teams to deliver robust growth systems.
Clients & Stakeholders: Interface directly with client-side developers, digital analysts, product managers, marketing leads, and technical business stakeholders.

bullets: 4+ years of hands-on experience in marketing technology, web analytics, personalization, experimentation, or related technical consulting/engineering roles.
Consulting & Agency Background: Prior client-facing, consulting, or agency experience preferred, with proven ability to lead discovery sessions, present solutions, and manage technical communication.
Adobe Target & Experimentation:
Deep experience building, implementing, and QA’ing A/B and multivariate tests.
Hands-on proficiency with VEC, form-based activities, custom code activities, Target Recommendations, and profile scripts.
Understanding of experimentation methodology (testable hypotheses, success/guardrail metrics, sample size, test duration, and statistical significance).
Implementation familiarity via Adobe Launch/Tags, at.js , and/or AEP Web SDK.
Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) & Real-Time CDP:

greenhouse:mewssystems:5032341101.summary:
The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

sections.title: About the role
paras: Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

You will own the relationship with US hotel customers from handover to go-live, guiding them through setup, training and rollout so the platform works for them from day one. The first weeks decide whether a customer adopts the product, stays and grows with us. Mews gives you a large customer base, complex multi-property rollouts and a team that backs your calls.

As a Customer Onboarding Manager, you are the main point of contact for your accounts. You run several mid-market and enterprise onboardings at once, often phased across properties or regions, working in English and Spanish with customers on one side and with Sales, Support and RevOps on the other, so that what was agreed in the sale is what gets delivered.

sections.title: What you would do
paras: AI Fluency Level 2: In this role, AI is part of your regular working week, for example drafting customer documentation, preparing training sessions and keeping project tracking up to date, and it makes you noticeably faster and better at onboarding work. Just as important, you read what it gives you critically, correct it, and only share it once you are sure it is accurate.
For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates on Confluence.
bullets: Own the customer relationship from handover through go-live and early adoption, as the day-to-day contact for your accounts
Run several onboarding projects at once, at different stages and levels of complexity, within SLA targets, including phased rollouts across multiple properties
Configure the product, advise on setup decisions, and flag configuration, data and timeline risks early, handling escalations as they arise
Train customer stakeholders, drive adoption, and keep Sales, Support and RevOps aligned to protect retention and set up future growth
Use AI to draft documentation, prepare for customer sessions and keep project tracking tidy, and check everything for accuracy before it reaches a customer or colleague

sections.title: What you would bring
bullets: Demonstrable experience in Account Management or Customer Success, including account ownership, retention, adoption, escalation handling and relationship management
Fluency in both English and Spanish, spoken and written is a must
Experience managing several customers or projects at once, ideally including phased rollouts across multiple sites
Strong communication and training skills for different customer stakeholders, and the ability to learn a complex SaaS product well enough to advise on setup
AI Fluency Level 2 in your day-to-day work, with the discernment to check AI output before you share it

sections.title: Nice to have
bullets: Hands-on SaaS onboarding or implementation experience, including configuration and integrations
Experience in hospitality technology or another multi-module SaaS or tech environment (PMS, POS, payments), though any strong customer-facing background is welcome
Experience contributing to onboarding playbooks, SOPs or team knowledge bases

A tech-forward mindset with a strong foundation in AI literacy. You maintain an openness and active willingness to innovate, leverage emerging technologies, collaborate across disciplines, and optimize both creative and operational workflows.
Strong proficiency in analytics and performance metrics to validate growth and optimize client programs.

Sweepstakes & Contest Administration: Lead contest logistics, including official rules, winner affidavits, prizing fulfillment, and regulatory (FTC/COPPA) compliance.

Regulatory Alignment & Compliance Verification: Liaise with Legal on client approvals, disclaimers, and usage rules, while serving as the on-set safeguard verifying that required brand presence and disclaimers are accurately captured.
Client On-Set Management & Live Pivots: Host client teams on set, guiding them through unscripted production changes and resolving roadblocks while protecting contractual deliverables.

sections.title: A day in the life:
paras: As an Associate Account Director, you will serve as the primary strategic partner for your clients on a day-to-day basis, owning the narrative around performance, identifying growth opportunities, and ensuring all marketing efforts ladder up to business objectives. A successful candidate is a strong cross-channel marketer and communicator who can confidently translate data into insights, guide internal teams, and build trust with clients. This is a critical role in ensuring accounts are not only running efficiently, but driving meaningful business impact. As an Associate Account Director (AAD), you will act as the day-to-day strategic lead for CPG clients, ensuring marketing efforts are aligned to revenue growth across DTC, retail, and Amazon ecosystems—not just individual channel performance.

You will work closely with client stakeholders across eCommerce, retail, and brand teams, helping navigate tradeoffs between channels, product launches, and campaign strategy. This role requires comfort discussing channel mix, retail dynamics, Amazon performance, and omnichannel measurement. You’ll partner with Project Managers to ensure execution stays on track, while collaborating with the Account Director to refine quarterly strategy and long-term growth plans.

Track performance across DTC, retail media, and Amazon ecosystems; identify cross-channel dynamics and surface insights to the client and AD
Coordinate paid, SEO, content, influencer, and creative teams around a unified account strategy

sections.title: About the Role
paras:
Roku’s experimentation platform is mature and widely adopted — about 90% of product areas run tests and rollouts through it. The business need for this role has risen: it is a product leadership position. The PM lead will own the long-term strategy for how Roku experiments, learns, and decides: running trustworthy tests at scale, linking experiment outcomes with direct viewer feedback, and translating both into roadmap, personalization, and AI product decisions/agentification loops. The charter requires tight scoping with Engineering leadership and spans Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Data Engineering, Recommendations, Ads/Martech, Finance, and User Research. This role requires excellent communication and deep empathy with cross-functional product and engineering counterparts as you solve complex testing and data challenges.

For California Only - The estimated annual base salary for this position is between $167,300 - $307,600. Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location. This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off.

sections.title: How will I use AI at Roku?
paras:
At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability.

We value curious, adaptable builders, who can show how they’ve used AI, agents, or automation to move faster, improve quality, and scale their impact. Strong candidates know how to frame problems, guide AI-assisted work, check the output, and learn quickly. Above all, they bring curiosity, adaptability, and sound judgment.

Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.
If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

sections.title: The Team:
paras: Upstart's Growth team is dedicated to creating a seamless product experience that allows customers to effortlessly discover and access Upstart's credit products, both for the first time and on an ongoing basis. By building exceptional, customer-centric experiences, this team plays a crucial role in making Upstart the premier destination for consumer credit, driving growth and unifying Upstart's product portfolio into a cohesive, multi-product marketplace.

As a Principal Product Manager, you will own the strategy and evolution of Upstart's end-to-end credit conversion experience, helping users move from intent, to the right credit offering, to approval and funding. You'll identify and solve the highest-leverage points of friction across the funnel, creating an experience that feels intelligently matched, transparent, and human while driving meaningful growth for the business.

This is a role with room to take big swings. Upstart has built a strong optimization muscle, and the next chapter is less about tuning individual screens and more about fundamentally rethinking how we engage users on their way to getting funded and achieving their financial goals.

sections.title: How you’ll make an impact
bullets: Own and evolve the strategy for Upstart's end-to-end conversion experience, from application start through offer acceptance and beyond.
Take on the hardest conversion problems with a customer-first mindset, such as helping users whose offer differs from what they requested understand their options and move forward with confidence.
Optimize across Upstart's credit portfolio, growing the core personal loan business while helping users find the product that best fits their needs.
Set the success metrics for your area and use them to prioritize the highest-ROI opportunities, experimenting where an experiment is the right way to decide.
Turn data into decisions, segmenting aggressively since aggregate conversion rates often mask very different user problems.
Build deep customer understanding alongside research, consumer insights, and product marketing so the borrower experience feels intuitive and human.
Influence without direct authority across engineering, design, analytics, ML, marketing, compliance, and executive leadership, creating clarity where ownership crosses teams.
Use GenAI as a real extension of your toolkit: synthesizing qualitative inputs, running exploratory analysis, and prototyping concepts to sharpen product conversations.

paras: Position location This role is available in the following locations: Remote

The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

paras: As Product Marketing Director, you'll own product marketing for Veeam DataAI Privacy, part of the Veeam DataAI Command Platform. DataAI Privacy helps organizations automate their privacy obligations across global data and AI regulations, reducing the complexity of meeting privacy requirements through data context and automated controls.

You'll own positioning, messaging, launches, campaign content, and sales enablement for DataAI Privacy in an established, fast-moving market where sharp differentiation wins. You'll be the hands-on expert who turns market, regulatory, and competitive insight into the stories, content, and enablement that move pipeline and win rate.

This is a senior role with the opportunity to grow with the business, for someone who leads with craft and can hold their own with product, sales, and executive leadership. Above all, you're passionate about protecting the privacy of people's data while helping companies reduce the complexity of meeting privacy requirements.

At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.

We’ve led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we’re evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI-ready foundation.

sections.title: The Opportunity
paras: Zuora’s Technical Account Managers are changing what post-sales looks like. We don’t work from a ticket queue or manage relationships from a distance. We embed with our customers, build solutions alongside them, and own the outcome end to end.

As a Technical Account Manager focused on Zuora Revenue, you’ll be the person our enterprise customers rely on to get revenue right. You’ll help them automate revenue recognition under ASC 606 and IFRS 15, close their books faster and with confidence, and make sure what Zuora Revenue reports ties out to billing and the general ledger. You’ll build AI-assisted proofs of concept (POCs) that show customers what’s possible in days, not months, and you’ll drive the adoption and measurable results that keep customers growing with us.

You’ll own a focused portfolio of enterprise accounts and work as part of a small team, stepping in on teammates’ accounts when your expertise is needed. You’ll partner directly with customers’ controllers, revenue accountants, finance systems and IT teams across the US and around the world.

sections.title: What you’ll own
bullets: Customer outcomes. Own the technical health, adoption and business results of your accounts. Know what success means to each customer in their own terms, such as a faster close, fewer manual journal entries, clean audits or a new pricing model recognized correctly, and drive toward it.

Revenue recognition solutions. Help customers apply Zuora Revenue to ASC 606 / IFRS 15: contracts and performance obligations, allocation, modifications, recognition schedules and reporting. Translate the accounting policy a customer’s team describes into a working design.

Revenue close and reconciliation. Help customers run a clean revenue close. Reconcile Zuora Revenue with billing and the general ledger, trace variances to their source, and fix problems at the root instead of handing them off.

The bigger picture. Look beyond Zuora Revenue to the whole revenue chain. Understand how upstream systems (CRM, CPQ, billing, contracts) shape the data that arrives in Zuora Revenue, and how what leaves it affects downstream systems like the ERP, general ledger and reporting. Spot problems where they start, not where they show up.

Integration design. Advise customers on how data and information flows into and out of Zuora Revenue: in from billing, CRM and other upstream systems, and out to their ERP, general ledger and other finance systems. Recommend best practices for each flow. Customers own their code, so you design and guide the approach.
AI-assisted proofs of concept. Use AI tools to build working POCs and data analyses that show value to customers quickly, then turn what works into lasting solutions.

Closing the loop. When an issue needs Product, Engineering or Support, you stay accountable: you bring in the right people, push for resolution and keep the customer informed. You turn what you learn into product feedback that shapes Zuora’s roadmap.
Customer AI adoption. Help customers adopt AI in their own finance and revenue workflows, including how Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and AI agents connect to SaaS platforms like Zuora.

sections.title: What success looks like
bullets: First 30 days: Get certified in a Zuora product area.
By 60 days: Embed with the TAM team on customer work, then take ownership of your first customer.
By 90 days: Own a full portfolio of accounts and drive measurable results for each.

sections.title: What we’re looking for
paras: We see two strong paths into this role. You don’t need both.
bullets: Fast learner: You’ve picked up new platforms, products or subject areas quickly and can show how. If you bring the drive, we’ll teach you Zuora and the revenue side.

Comfort with financial concepts and numbers: You’re at ease working with ledgers, schedules, reconciliations and large data sets, and you can explain what the numbers mean. You don’t need to be a certified accountant.
Builder mindset: You’d rather prototype a solution than write a slide about one, and you can point to things you’ve built or automated.
AI fluency: You use AI tools in your daily work to move faster on prototyping, POCs, data analysis and solution design, and you can show examples. You understand MCPs and how they apply in SaaS.
Working with data and systems: You’ve used SQL, scripts or similar tools to analyze data, and you understand how data and information move between systems, or you’re ready to pick it up fast.

Customer focus: You understand how a customer’s business works and tie your work to their results, not just their tickets. You can explain complex accounting or technical topics clearly to finance and IT teams.
Ownership: You take full accountability for results and close the loop on what you start.
Attention to detail: Customers trust your numbers, your designs and your commitments.

smartrecruiters:renesaselectronics:74400.summary:
We're hiring a Senior Director of Customer Success to own how enterprise electronics teams adopt, standardize on, and expand their use of Altium 365 and the broader Altium platform, including our growing set of AI-assisted capabilities. This is a defining hire. Customer success at Altium isn't a check-in function. It's how we turn design tools into embedded engineering infrastructure, and how we protect and grow an annual recurring revenue base.

Our product doesn't behave like a typical SaaS tool, and neither can this role. Altium 365 isn't used daily by everyone. It's used intensely at design milestones, in design reviews, during component selection, and at release to manufacturing. Monthly active users tell you very little about whether a customer is getting value. You'll build the adoption model that does: one that ties real engineering workflows to renewal and expansion outcomes,…

sections.title: Job Description
paras: AI is changing this role in two ways, and you'll lead both. First, you'll drive customer adoption of Altium's AI capabilities, e.g., AI assistants, intelligent component and library guidance, automated design checks, helping engineering organizations move from curiosity to trusted, governed use in real design workflows. Second, you'll make AI a core part of how our own Customer Success team operates, from health scoring to renewal preparation.

You'll report to the President of Altium, and partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, Professional Services, and Support. Our customers are electrical engineers, PCB designers, engineering managers, librarians, and operations and supply chain leaders. They are technical, opinionated, and deeply attached to their workflows, and many work in regulated industries where trust in a new capability has to be earned. You'll earn their trust by understanding how they actually design hardware.

sections.title: How the role is shaped
paras: We serve customers through three motions, and you'll architect and operate all of them:
bullets: Scaled / digital: Automated onboarding, in-product guidance, and self-serve learning for small teams and individual designers. Engagement is signal-driven and scaled through content, community, and AI-assisted support.
Mid-touch: Pooled CSM coverage for engineering teams that are growing, adopting collaboration and component management, and ready to standardize.

sections.title: What you'll do
paras: Define what "adoption" means for a non-DAU product:
Drive customer adoption of AI capabilities:
Build the learning and enablement engine:
bullets: Own gross and net revenue retention across segments and regions, with accountability for forecast accuracy.
Build the infrastructure to see risk and opportunity early: renewal risk, seat contraction, stalled rollouts, and whitespace across business units and sites.
Run a disciplined renewal and expansion rhythm with Sales, covering who owns what, when, and with what playbook.
Determine whether adoption of AI capabilities influences retention and expansion, and build it into forecasting and packaging conversations if it does.

Replace blunt MAU reporting with a workflow-based adoption model. Examples are seat activation against entitlement, projects created and released through Altium 365, shared workspace and design review usage, managed component and library adoption, and supply chain and BOM feature usage. These should be segmented by role, team, and site.

Add AI adoption to that model, going beyond "tried it once" to depth: which workflows use AI assistance, by which roles, how often within a design cycle, and with what observable effect on outcomes such as review cycles, library quality, or time to release.
Define leading indicators of retention and expansion, validate them against historical renewal and churn data, and turn them into health scores, alerts, and playbooks the team uses weekly.
Work with Product and Data teams to instrument the product so these signals exist. Be an opinionated voice on what we should be measuring and why.

sections.title: Qualifications
bullets: 10+ years in customer success, post-sales, or account management for enterprise technology, with 5+ years leading managers and teams. Directors should have led teams of 10+. Senior Directors should have led through managers across regions.
A track record of improving adoption, GRR, and NRR on complex enterprise accounts, with results you can quantify.

Experience in a product where usage is workflow-driven and episodic rather than daily, such as EDA, CAD, PLM, simulation, engineering software, or other complex B2B platforms. You've had to define "healthy" without relying on DAU or WAU.
Strong analytical skills. You can design a health model, test it against renewal outcomes, and explain its limits to executives.
Hands-on experience driving adoption of new AI or automation capabilities with customers, ideally in technical or regulated environments, and a realistic view of both the value and the limits.
Direct experience deploying AI-driven workflows inside a CS organization, with a clear point of view on where AI improves productivity and where human judgment must stay in the loop.
Experience building customer education and enablement programs (academies, certifications, role-based learning) and tying them to business outcomes.
Experience selling, renewing, and expanding in engineering-led buying environments, including multi-site and multi-business-unit enterprises, with long cycles and many stakeholders.

smartrecruiters:servicenow:7440001501215.summary:
We work in pods - small, dedicated teams embedded with a single enterprise customer, building their voice agents from first call to self-sufficiency. A pod owns the full lifecycle: agent shadowing, conversation design, build, production go-live, and the handoff that makes the customer self-sufficient so the pod can move on to the next one. Each pod pairs forward-deployed engineers with a product manager who owns both the customer outcome and the product learning that comes from it.

Every PM on this team runs at least one pod directly and has visibility across others. You're in the customer's world - on their calls, in their systems, solving their problems - while simultaneously shaping what the product becomes. The learnings from your pods feed directly into the platform roadmap and into repeatable, productized assets that scale beyond any single customer.

sections.title: What This Role Owns:
bullets: You run two pods closely - hands-on through the full build lifecycle with two enterprise customers simultaneously, from agent shadowing through production go-live. You'll become one of the most experienced people in the company at knowing what it actually takes to ship a voice agent that works in the real world.

sections.title: Why This and Not Somewhere Else:
paras: This role puts you directly in front of enterprise customers running production voice AI from day one. You're not waiting to earn customer exposure - it's the job. The pod model means you'll accumulate more production voice AI experience in a year than most PMs get in several, across different industries, different contact center environments, and different conversation types. At the same time, the evaluation frameworks and agentic design patterns you build have reach well beyond your own pods. This team has a direct seat at the platform table, so the tooling you create shapes how ServiceNow thinks about voice agent quality at scale.

sections.title: What You Bring:
bullets: 5+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience in a technical role such as engineering, solutions consulting, or technical program management where you owned product outcomes.
Comfort with data and evaluation. You think naturally about how to measure whether something is working and how to build systems that do it at scale.
Experience working directly with customers or end users on technical products. You don't need enterprise sales experience, but you need to have been in the room where the work happens.
Strong technical foundation. You can read code, understand API contracts, and hold your own with engineers on system design.
An instinct for repeatable process. You see a problem solved once and immediately think about how to solve it for every customer.

sections.title: Even Better:
bullets: Experience with conversational AI, voice technology, or contact center operations.
Background building evaluation frameworks, QA automation, or analytics products.
Familiarity with agentic AI design patterns and how to give an AI agent reliable, structured behavior alongside open-ended reasoning.
Coding ability in any language. You won't write production code, but PMs on this team who can prototype, script, and dig into data move faster.
Experience with telephony environments: SIP, CCaaS platforms, real-time media handling.

smartrecruiters:vuoriinc:744000157925689.summary: As AI and Planning Science Product Manager, you will be responsible for maintaining the roadmap and driving successful delivery of Vuori's data science and machine learning products. Your primary focus will span two connected domains: planning science capabilities — forecasting, inventory optimization, demand sensing, and the ML models that power smarter merchandising and supply chain decisions — and customer and consumer analytics, including models and data products that deepen understanding of customer behavior, lifetime value, segmentation, and personalization. You will also flex into agentic AI and generative AI initiatives as the portfolio evolves.

sections.title: Job Description
paras: This role is a strong fit for a product practitioner who is comfortable working closely with data scientists and ML engineers, translating complex modeling work into products that business teams actually use and trust. You will keep delivery moving, ensure requirements are clear and grounded in real business needs, and stay close to outcomes so the team always knows whether the work is landing.

sections.title: What you'll get to do:
bullets: Keep the planning science and consumer AI product roadmap current, sequenced, and visible — balancing near-term delivery with longer-horizon model and platform investments across both planning and customer domains.

Work with merchandising, supply chain, finance, marketing, e-commerce, and technology partners to surface high-value opportunities for data science and ML, and bring them into the roadmap through a clear prioritization process.
Facilitate trade-off conversations between business stakeholders and data science teams, helping groups reach decisions grounded in data and realistic about what modeling can deliver.
Communicate roadmap status, sequencing changes, and delivery progress on a regular cadence so stakeholders are not surprised and plans remain credible.
Surface dependencies, data readiness gaps, and model risk issues early so teams have time to address them before they become blockers.

Translate business planning, operational, and customer-facing needs into clear, detailed product requirements, model evaluation criteria, and acceptance standards that data science and engineering teams can build against.

Work alongside data scientists and ML engineers throughout development — clarifying scope, reviewing model outputs, aligning on evaluation frameworks, and making fast decisions when requirements need to adapt.

Ensure model outputs are properly integrated into business workflows and decision tools — not just technically functional, but genuinely usable by the planners, marketers, merchants, and operators who depend on them.

sections.title: Who you are:
bullets: Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent years of experience preferred.
8+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years working directly with data science or machine learning teams on products shipped to real users in production environments.
Demonstrated track record of managing a roadmap and delivering data science or ML features end to end, with measurable business outcomes across planning, operations, or customer-facing domains.
Strong ability to work alongside data scientists and ML engineers — comfortable discussing modeling approaches, evaluation of metrics, and data requirements at a meaningful level of depth.
Experience translating business planning, forecasting, customer analytics, or operational needs into clear model requirements and product specifications.
Familiarity with the full ML lifecycle — data preparation, model development, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring — and the product considerations at each stage.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make modeling work legible and credible to business, executive, and technical audiences alike.
Strong organizational skills and a consistent bias toward action, with comfort navigating the inherent uncertainty of data science delivery.
